name: Mise Altoise
source: Maitress (teacher) of Agnes and Aberdeen and maker of Minette and Avril. Used to be an adventurer, along with Fabious, Nagan and Shelley. Famed to be the best doll maker of the world. Her currents whereabouts are unknown. Supposedly, her personality is similar to Ritos's.
